title: ComplianceNoted
tagline: Compliance for on-chain private equity: manage a portfolio or a fund with an array of accounts and breathe through client reporting and compliance requirements! Privacy, efficiency and portability all in place.

prizes.placement: 🥈 Ethereum Foundation — Best use of TLSNotary
prizes.title: Ethereum Foundation

description:
The realms of Web2 and Web3 finance share a common challenge, one that revolves around the intricate domain of compliance and the imperative aspect of client reporting. In the context of crypto Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) portfolios, a pivotal quandary arises concerning the assessment of their efficiency and the maintenance of confidentiality with regard to second-level positions. In this ever-evolving landscape, where the amalgamation of traditional Web2 financial structures and decentralized Web3 platforms is increasingly prevalent, the need for a comprehensive solution is paramount.

In response to this pressing need, ComplianceNoted emerges as a groundbreaking solution that is meticulously designed to address the dual imperatives of privacy and trade compliance in the intricate domains of both Web2 and Web3. Leveraging the robust security framework of Transport Layer Security (TLS) Notary, ComplianceNoted pioneers a pioneering approach to safeguarding sensitive financial information, thereby ushering in a new era of confidentiality and regulatory adherence in the world of digital finance. Through its innovative implementation of TLS Notary, ComplianceNoted ensures the utmost privacy of crypto ETF portfolio holdings while simultaneously guaranteeing compliance with stringent regulatory mandates.

In essence, ComplianceNoted stands as a beacon of assurance for financial institutions operating in the ever-evolving Web2 and Web3 finance space. Its capacity to shield second-level positions from inadvertent exposure ensures that the sensitive intricacies of crypto ETF portfolios remain confidential, while its unwavering commitment to trade compliance ensures that all regulatory obligations are met with unwavering precision. This multifaceted solution serves as a testament to the transformative power of cutting-edge technology in harmonizing the often disparate worlds of traditional finance and blockchain-based financial systems, ultimately paving the way for a more secure and compliant financial future.
how_its_made: ComplianceNoted uses the TLSN server and TLSN infrastructure to create a framework of market and trade data verification. The project is fully built on Rust with a client side server and DNS, IPv4 and TLS. The TLSN library uses multiple popular crates in cryptography for Rust including primitives and IOs.
